title: KMS Environment Readiness Checker

transitions.note: Created after operational audit found the generic env checker did not cover the prepared Stage 3 KMS runtime contract.
Add a dedicated kms mode requiring region, role ARN and KMS key id while rejecting static AWS credentials. Keep basic/full CI behavior unchanged until the live AWS gate is enabled.
PR CI and Vercel preview passed. Dedicated kms mode requires AWS_REGION/AWS_ROLE_ARN/AI_CREDENTIAL_KMS_KEY_ID and rejects static AWS credentials with fatal exit code.
KMS env readiness gate completed without AWS calls, env mutation, database changes, provider traffic or paid usage.

notes: Ready for later live AWS/Vercel setup. Run `npm run env:check -- --mode=kms` before invoking the prepared KMS canary. Example/reference env files are synchronized in a follow-up docs-only PR.
